services.name: Group Tours and Rentals
services.desc: With five museums, we are a popular location for group tours. We have ample parking for cars, buses, and motorcoaches in the municipal parking lot on Market St. We offer tours of any and all of the five museums, as well as canal walks and historical village walks. We are able to tailor group tours to address particular themes and areas of focus, such as the Underground Railroad, Women’s History, Erie Canal History, the paranormal, and more. We have a meeting space and a fully functional kitchen in the Alling Coverlet Museum for smaller groups and a large room off of this space for larger gatherings. We also have a TV, DVD player, projector, and microphone available if needed. Consider

blurb: Built in 1826 along Palmyra’s busy Market Street, the Wm. Phelps General Store served travelers and canal workers during the height of the Erie Canal era.
